## About
Automotive Performance Specialists is a family-owned and operated shop on W. Shangri-La Rd. in Phoenix. We take care of all of your vehicle maintenance and repairs, from A/C and brakes to steering and suspension.
Our ASE certified technicians use computer diagnostics so you're not guessing. One reviewer wrote that Mike "explained everything to me in detail so I could understand the repair." That's how we like to do it.
We're rated 4.9 from 58 Google reviews. Stop by Monday through Friday, or call and tell us how we can help.

## Services
- A/C system check with Freon top off: Keep cool all summer long with a complete A/C system check and Freon top off.
- Brakes: Get your brakes serviced and stay safe on the road.
- Steering & Suspension: Steering and suspension work to keep your car handling the way it should.
- Vehicle maintenance and repairs: The upkeep and repairs that keep your car running, handled by the same crew every time.
- Computer diagnostics: We check your car with computer diagnostics, so you know what's wrong before any work starts.

## FAQ
Q: Do you offer a military discount?
A: Yes. Get a 10 percent military discount when you present your ID at the time of write-up.

Q: Can I get a quote?
A: Sure. Call the shop or email Mechanics@PeoriaAutomotive.com and tell us how we can help.

Q: Do you do performance work?
A: We do. One customer had us install a steering wheel in his Monte Carlo and said it looks great.
